scope: One paired nighttime lighting concept for each of 24 rooms/spaces; existing daytime views retained.
provenance: Edits use the exact current photo-derived or plan-led render as input; inherited geometry limitations remain. No text-to-image requests.

requests.title: Entrance gallery
requests.lighting: Let the existing two-story cascade chandelier provide a soft warm glow, each glass pendant legible without clipped glare. Subdued existing ceiling lights illuminate the oak path and the stair beyond; the arch lettering and light glazed doors remain visible. No light strips tracing arches or railings.

params.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. PHOTO EDIT, not a new interior design. Image 1 is the exact existing Mineral & Walnut room render to edit. Room: Entrance gallery. Scene: Evening arrival.
Change ONLY time of day and electric illumination. Lock the original camera, crop, perspective, proportions, all walls, every window and door, stair geometry, furniture position and design, finishes, artwork and existing text. Preserve all existing details even where only partially seen. Keep the same composition and aspect ratio.
Lighting intent: Let the existing two-story cascade chandelier provide a soft warm glow, each glass pendant legible without clipped glare. Subdued existing ceiling lights illuminate the oak path and the stair beyond; the arch lettering and light glazed doors remain visible. No light strips tracing arches or railings.
Target lamp appearance approximately 2700K with good color fidelity. True nighttime outside, deep dark neutral-blue sky with faint existing townhome streetscape where visible; absolutely no daylight shafts or glowing daylight curtains. Remove ALL direct sunlight patches and daylight illumination, including in mirrors and adjoining spaces. Realistic inverse light falloff, balanced interior-photography exposure, soft shadows, natural reflections in glass and polished metal. All light must come from a plausible described fixture; do not just apply a blue filter or darken the image. Show readable materials and lighting hierarchy, no crushed-black room or amber cast. Keep any curtains exactly where they are to allow direct comparison; nighttime privacy will be specified separately. No new furniture, ornaments, candles, plants, windows, ceiling coves, chandelier types, LED strips beyond the explicit lighting intent, people, pets, logos or new text. Preserve source inscriptions verbatim. Output a single photoreal room image, not a collage or before/after. This is a lighting-intent concept, not a measured illuminance simulation.
